primary_antecedent.receiving_contribution: A complete uniform finite-order strict-diffraction estimate from an actual incoming interior cap, including stationary projected boundary fields, fixed final geometry, original Banach control and full scalar source/observation tests.

source_correspondence: H0–H1 retain the full scalar differential family, complex lower coefficients, original Banach norm, actual zero trace, full bounded target families and one fixed incoming cap. No nonradial projected boundary field is assumed.

G0 proves uniform minimum-section bounds and continuity of the broken hitting map, including the square-root corner. The accessible region is open in total parameter space; the compact target and parameter neighborhood precede all regularity orders.

I0 retains both full roots, their complete Riccati remainder, transported lower coefficients and the actual incoming equation. Uniform root gaps are required only on each selected compact incoming support.

I1 proves the averaged strip estimate with the positive-i Duhamel sign. The negative-root joint parametrix retains unbounded normal frequencies and gives an ordinary cap test of exactly one higher order.

L0 uses the explicit strict commutants with compact parameter bounds, a positive two-row determinant and positive order-dependent incoming gaps. The set of glancing centers need not be a smooth manifold.

L1 makes the full energy estimate homogeneous and quantitative at every real order. It retains the true regularized equation, source pairings, coarse localized pairs, exact zero-value boundary cancellation and every tangential residual.

B0 obtains finite inequalities in the elliptic, transverse and interior regimes. It proves interior nonradiality, retains full graph-source factorization before ordinary source testing, and includes high-normal frequencies and negative-order weight comparisons.

B1 proves a finite induction on the same total open region. Boundary estimates are established before interior paths use them; compact covers and finite trees never require an infinite intersection or a countable-test closed-graph argument.

S0 proves the exact gauge and trace, original Banach coarse estimate and actual ratio-kernel forcing identity. Transition-band ellipticity and the exterior normal derivative retain all admissible source branches without differentiating the forcing normally.
S1 recovers the full original targets on the correct input, transfers cap observations and retains full residuals even when their kernels reach the boundary.

S2 applies the proved scalar chart assembly separately to the finite source and observation lists. Full residuals cannot cancel the elliptic output; the chart and positive tangential dimension remain explicit.
C0 extends only to the actual completed tested graph and proves its injection into distributions. A continuous Banach trace, when available, preserves the limiting zero value.

Three complete solutions check the stationary boundary-field model, exact cap time and displacement across all three regimes, and exact commutant row slopes and incoming gaps. The original figure uses the stated base coordinates and continuous travel-time formula.
Every displayed formula parsed, desktop width fit, and mobile display and figure scroll extents were checked.
The full transitive map retains explicitly external human foundation providers.
